title: Resolution urging Albany to require SUNY and CUNY composting
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5713/A.3249, which would require SUNY and CUNY institutions to separate compostable waste in dormitories, dining facilities and maintenance operations. The bill would also require SUNY and CUNY trustees to annually report on their composting programs. It aims to close gaps left by existing state and City organic waste recycling laws that exclude many college facilities.
